description:
Record a manual payment on an order that is awaiting payment (payment_status="pending"). Use payment_method="sales_channel" for an order already paid on its storefront (Shopify/WooCommerce/Wix — the channel is the source of payment), or "stripe" for an order taken through ApparelHub's own card flow. This marks the order paid; it does not charge a card.

[#81d42b]

amount.description: Optional amount for the caller's intent; the recorded amount comes from the order total.

payment_method.description: e.g. "sales_channel" (paid on the storefront) or "stripe" (ApparelHub card flow).

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: record_order_payment
